'''Roboda Beehaz''' was the wife of [[Commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]] and mother of [[Leonart Beehaz]]. She and her son were taken captive by [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebels]] during the [[Aldhani heist]] in order to make her husband co-operate.<ref name="Episode6" />
